purpose: Bounded NSESche-only development after the complete formal V94 E01-E20 block established first-ranked throughput in all four E3/E4 scenarios but failed the QPR gate in spike, pulse, and steady. Compare only already-implemented SRPT-ready placement experts with independent prior evidence; do not change the paper utility, common runtime, HPA, resources, workload, baselines, or binary.

mechanism_evidence.interpretation: These profiles were defined and exercised before V95. Hiku-family and load-aware experts independently targeted the latency-cost denominator that limited formal QPR, while the SRPT-ready frontier preserves the completion mechanism responsible for V94 throughput. Candidate membership is mechanism-driven and not chosen from E726-E731 outcomes.

candidate_pairs.rationale: Use the faithful Hiku/load composition for burst QPR and the frozen current-demand LoadLeast expert for the steady latency-cost denominator.
Use a two-Hiku-to-one-OCS ordinal compromise for bursts and an equal faithful-FaaSRank/LoadLeast ordinal compromise for steady QoS.
Use an OCS-heavy burst compromise to protect completion and a Hiku-heavy steady compromise to reduce the latency-cost product.

candidate_constraints.information_boundary: Online expert scores use only current preplacement state and frozen model/history inputs; seed labels, outcomes, QPR, and frozen thresholds are not online inputs.

training_matrix.reference_note: Reference build specs bind NASH_OPERATIONAL_EXPERT_PROXY because it changes the initial assignment and state/hash sequence; therefore each candidate requires its own 12 references.

selection_gate.per_scenario_rule: For each candidate/scenario/metric, all E726-E728 values must satisfy the metric's validity rules and the complete three-seed arithmetic mean must be strictly greater than the frozen formal-n20 maximum baseline mean; ties fail.
selection_gate.E3_pass_rule: One E3 profile must pass all nine E3 scenario-by-metric gates.
selection_gate.E4_pass_rule: One E4 profile must pass all three E4 metric gates.
selection_gate.multiple_passer_rule: Within E3 and E4 independently, choose the passer with the largest minimum relative margin across its required gates, then the largest mean relative margin, then lexicographically smallest candidate_id.
selection_gate.joint_rule: Both an E3 winner and an E4 winner are required before E729-E731 may be opened. The selected mapping may combine profiles from different candidate-pair manifests exactly as preregistered here.
selection_gate.blindness_rule: Complete all tapes, all 36 candidate-specific references, and all 36 online runs before one result-blind audit. Reveal all candidate performance exactly once after identity, hash, attempt, QC, pairing, reference, and coverage gates pass.
selection_gate.failure_action: Freeze the complete V95 training cohort, do not open E729-E731, do not replace seeds or selectively rerun completed scientific results, and return to mechanism diagnosis.
selection_gate.success_action: Freeze the independently selected E3/E4 profile mapping and exact runtime, then write a separate E729-E731 confirmation plan before generating those inputs. Training rows remain excluded from publication-group closure.
